headlines.title: Pappas questions whether Americans are feeling Trump's 'golden age' after primary win
headlines.description: Rep. Chris Pappas asked voters if they feel they are living in President Trump’s "golden age" after his projected win in New Hampshire's Democratic Senate primary.

headlines.title: Conflicting court rulings leave Missouri’s congressional map in limbo
headlines.description: Republicans rushed to the high court after the Missouri Supreme Court ruled the state could not use the redrawn map, which was designed to eliminate one Democratic-held seat, this year.

headlines.title: US Destroys 5 Iranian Oil Tankers as War Escalates Once Again
headlines.description: The United States struck five Iranian oil tankers in the Gulf of Oman following an attack on an American warship by Iran. Now, the growing tensions are triggering yet another major spike in oil and gas prices. It comes as President Donald Trump is threatening to ban some food and alcohol imports from Canada. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Iran attacks American warships and base after U.S. sinks five Iranian tankers
headlines.description: They’re the latest tit-for-tat strikes as Washington and Tehran lurch back toward fighting during more than six months of war.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy Jurors Speak Out on Mistrial and the Lone Holdout
headlines.description: For the first time, members of the jury in the closely-watched Lindsay Clancy trial are speaking out on the tense dayslong deliberations over Clancy’s fate. They sat down exclusively with Sue O’Connell from NBC affiliate NBC10 Boston and revealed what evidence moved them the most and their thoughts on the man they say caused the mistrial. NBC’s Laura Jarrett reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Rhode Island primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Rhode Island, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first since July as Middle East conflict intensifies again
headlines.description: The price of oil breached the $100 threshold Wednesday for the first time since July, as new flare-ups in the United States’ war with Iran stoked fresh concern for global energy markets.
